mapper.select: SELECT a.MOIM_ID ,a.MOIM_TITLE ,a.MOIM_DSCR ,a.MOIM_START_DT ,a.MOIM_END_DT ,d.USER_NM ,COALESCE(v.VISIT_CNT, 0) AS VISIT_CNT ,a.MAX_MEMBER ,COALESCE(m.MEMBER_CNT, 0) AS MEMBER_CNT ,c.CATE_CD ,c.CATE_NM FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_USER_INFO d ON a.CREATE_USER = d.USER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MOIM_ID ,COUNT(USER_ID) AS MEMBER_CNT FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMER GROUP BY MOIM_ID ) m ON a.MOIM_ID = m.MOIM_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MOIM_ID ,COUNT(VISIT_ID) AS VISIT_CNT FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_VISIT_H GROUP BY MOIM_ID ) v ON a.MOIM_ID = v.MOIM_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.MOIM_ID ,GROUP_CONCAT(e.CATE_CD ORDER BY e.CATE_CD) AS CATE_CD ,GROUP_CONCAT(f.CMM_CM_NM ORDER BY f.CMM_CM_NM) AS CATE_NM FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_CATE e LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D f ON e.CATE_CD = f.CMM_CDV AND f.CMM_CD_ID = 'CATE_ID' AND f.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY e.MOIM_ID ) c ON a.MOIM_ID = c.MOIM_ID WHERE a.MOIM_ID = #{moimId}

SELECT a.MOIM_ID ,a.MOIM_TITLE ,a.MOIM_DSCR ,a.MOIM_START_DT ,a.MOIM_END_DT ,a.MAX_MEMBER ,a.MOIM_IMG_URL AS IMAGE_URL ,COUNT(c.USER_ID) AS memberCnt ,a.CREATE_USER AS USER_ID ,b.USER_NM ,AVG(d.REVIEW_SCORE) AS REVIEW_SCORE FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_USER_INFO b ON a.CREATE_USER = b.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMBER c ON a.MOIM_ID = c.MOIM_ID AND c.ROLE_CD = 'A' LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_MOIM_REVIEW d ON a.MOIM_ID = d.MOIM_ID AND d.REVIEW_TYPE_CD = 'O' WHERE a.MOIM_ID = #{moimId} GROUP BY a.MOIM_ID ,a.MOIM_TITLE ,a.MOIM_DSCR ,a.MOIM_START_DT ,a.MOIM_END_DT ,a.MAX_MEMBER ,a.MOIM_IMG_URL ,a.CREATE_USER ,b.USER_NM

SELECT b.CMM_CDV AS CATE_CD ,b.CMM_CM_NM AS CATE_NM FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_CATE a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D b ON a.CATE_CD = b.CMM_CDV AND b.CMM_CD_ID = 'CATE_ID' AND b.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE a.MOIM_ID = #{moimId}

SELECT a.START_DT ,a.RMKS ,b.TOUR_NM ,d.CMM_CDV AS CATE_CD ,d.CMM_CM_NM AS CATE_NM FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_CALENDAR a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST b ON a.TOUR_ID = b.TOUR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_CATE c ON b.TOUR_ID = c.TOUR_ID AND c.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D d ON c.CATE_CD = d.CMM_CDV AND d.CMM_CD_ID = 'TOUR_LCLS_CD' WHERE a.MOIM_ID = #{moimId} ORDER BY a.RMKS
SELECT a.ROLE_CD ,a.STATE_CD FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMBER a WHERE 1=1 AND a.MOIM_ID = #{moimId} AND a.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT a.MOIM_ID ,a.MOIM_TITLE ,a.MOIM_DSCR ,a.MOIM_START_DT ,a.MOIM_END_DT ,a.MAX_MEMBER ,COALESCE(m.MEMBER_CNT, 0) AS MEMBER_CNT ,my_m.ROLE_CD ,my_m.STATE_CD ,c.CATE_CD ,c.CATE_NM FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MOIM_ID, COUNT(USER_ID) AS MEMBER_CNT FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMBER GROUP BY MOIM_ID ) m ON a.MOIM_ID = m.MOIM_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.MOIM_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(e.CATE_CD ORDER BY e.CATE_CD) AS CATE_CD, GROUP_CONCAT(f.CMM_CM_NM ORDER BY f.CMM_CM_NM) AS CATE_NM FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_CATE e LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D f ON e.CATE_CD = f.CMM_CDV AND f.CMM_CD_ID = 'CATE_ID' AND f.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY e.MOIM_ID ) c ON a.MOIM_ID = c.MOIM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMBER my_m ON my_m.MOIM_ID = a.MOIM_ID WHERE a.USE_YN = 'Y' AND my_m.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT a.CMM_CDV AS CATE_CD ,a.CMM_CM_NM AS CATE_NM FROM TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D a WHERE a.CMM_CD_ID = 'CATE_ID' AND a.USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT a.USER_ID ,b.USER_NM ,a.ROLE_CD ,a.STATE_CD FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMBER a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_USER_INFO b ON a.USER_ID = b.USER_ID WHERE a.MOIM_ID = #{moimId} ORDER BY a.ROLE_CD, a.CREATE_DT

SELECT b.USER_NM ,a.REVIEW_SCORE ,a.REVIEW_CONTENT ,a.IMG_URLS ,a.CREATE_DT FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_REVIEW a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_USER_INFO b ON a.CREATE_USER = b.USER_ID WHERE a.REVIEW_TYPE_CD = 'O' AND a.MOIM_ID = #{moimId} ORDER BY a.CREATE_DT DESC
